speech.heard: Germany's students spend nine years in secondary school. In the USA, it is just six. This counts the total number of grades a student completes in secondary school. Germany is the world's highest, nine years of classrooms and study. In the USA, that journey is shorter, six years. Germany has 1.5 times the years of schooling you get in the USA. The global median is six years. China and Japan both match that. Slovakia matches the top at nine. India and Russia have seven. South Africa has five. How many years of secondary school did you finish?
